title: 法巴资管Catarina：AI硬件之后，软件接棒了吗？
speaker: E. Catarina Bego

segments.en: Would that still be up, you know, on the upper end of the stack, you know, chips, energy, hyperscalers, or do you start to move down the sort of infrastructure AI stack?
segments.zh: 机会仍在产业链上游，如芯片、能源、大型科技企业，还是开始向下游基础设施转移？

segments.en: The infrastructure AI stack, I think, there was all the part that was more in question coming into kind of the summer was the software. As you know, the hardware did very, very well in this AI store, the software was lagging, and what we see through the summer month, we've seen the earnings and some of the software companies starting to crystallize in much of my stronger manner, and we've seen the recovery in that space.
segments.zh: AI基础设施中，夏季前最受质疑的是软件。硬件表现很好，软件落后，但夏季我们看到部分软件公司业绩明显兑现，该领域出现修复。

segments.en: So I would say hardware is still going to continue because we're still deploying in training those models, in driving those compute capacity, but at the same time, investors are going to pay a lot more attention as where the software is going, where is the application going, who is putting the next kind of application on top of their kind of structures, like I said, Northern order was came just last night, or the night before, and again, a critical move in a sense that this could lead to new innovation for that company, right?
segments.zh: 硬件仍会继续，因为模型训练和算力部署仍在推进。但投资者会更关注软件和应用走向，谁在现有结构上叠加新应用。就像昨晚或前晚北欧企业的动作，可能带来新创新。

segments.en: And again, if they lead to new drugs, new innovation, that's improved earnings, that improves again the credibility of the AI store as well.
segments.zh: 如果带来新药、新创新，就会改善盈利，也会提升AI叙事的可信度。

segments.en: Good point. Yeah, we are seeing that application of AI into the healthcare sector in China as well. How do you play the AI story in China? It seems like it's kind of a bit different sort of circumstances, models, everything, right? How do you position around that, Dean?
segments.zh: 好观点。中国医疗领域也在应用AI。您如何参与中国的AI叙事？那里的环境、模型似乎有所不同，您如何布局？
